description: MUTATES Codat state — queue a refresh of ONE data type for a company (e.g. "invoices", "bills", "chartOfAccounts", "balanceSheet"). Asynchronous: it enqueues a pull, it does not return the data. Codat API: POST /companies/{companyId}/data/queue/{dataType}.

dataType.description: The Codat data type key to refresh, e.g. "invoices", "bills", "customers", "chartOfAccounts", "balanceSheet".

name: codat_refresh_data_type
title: Queue a single dataset refresh
